observations.why: The phrase 'Owned intelligence' frames self-origination and possession of one's own cognitive capacity as the appealed-to good.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Framing perspective as a kept asset appeals to self-origination (autonomy) and to personal standing or achievement (self-enhancement).
The compound 'individually-owned-intelligence' restates the self-origination value, naming individual ownership as the thesis being positioned.
